accepted-duplicate-reads.note: 1000 accepted retries and owner reads; no native replay or writes

accepted-interrupt.note: Existing durable interrupting transition before native RPC, no retirement before terminal

accepted-origin.note: One accepted native steer's causal origin boundary; setup and native turn creation excluded

duplicate-interrupt.note: 1000 repeated interrupts while confirmed interrupt is pending; no native replay or writes

ordinary-steer.note: Actual ordinary steering; no origin or persistence, zero commits

origin-completion-retry.note: Retry only the refused origin boundary after native acceptance

origin-write-refusal.note: Refused host retention after native acceptance; no durable write and no provider replay

refused-interrupt.note: Existing interrupting and restoration boundaries after provider refusal

terminal-during-interrupt.note: Interrupting plus confirmed provider terminal; late refusal makes no restoration write
